selectionDataset.name: Polyvore Outfit validation Cart completion
selectionDataset.source: xthan/polyvore-dataset; Learning Fashion Compatibility with Bidirectional LSTMs (ACM MM 2017)
selectionDataset.split: Official valid_no_dup outfits; deterministic held-out item and sampled candidates
selectionDataset.notes: A deterministic item is held out from each validation outfit and ranked among 200 candidates. Category-level association lift is learned from train_no_dup only. Gender and brand are unavailable; the style proxy uses color words and price similarity.

objective: Maximize NDCG@5; deterministic tie-breaks: HR, MAP, MRR, Recall, Precision, Coverage

constraints.note: The public evaluation datasets lack equivalent production business signals, so their weights were not tuned.

cart.warning: Polyvore provides outfit-completion labels, but unavailable production attributes are represented only by the documented metadata proxy.
